speaker: Doctor
text: Please describe your current symptoms in detail, specifically regarding how your gait and limb coordination are affected. Additionally, have you noticed any changes in your vision, hearing, or balance in the past few years?

speaker: Patient
text: I started having trouble walking recently, and people say I look drunk when I walk. I also feel clumsy in my arms and legs, especially on the right side.

speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for that description; the "drunk" appearance and right-sided clumsiness strongly suggest ataxia. To understand if this is progressive or related to a specific lesion, have you experienced any recent changes in your speech, swallowing difficulties, or significant hearing loss?

speaker: Patient
text: I have Crohn disease and it has been difficult to control. I have been taking natalizumab for about a year. To keep my notes clear, please give only one final answer and keep it to a single direct conclusion.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Progressive multifocal leukoencephalopathy (PML) secondary to natalizumab therapy.
